rows.scope: Bounded independent final review of the current-byte Arkansas Veterans Treatment Court candidate after the completed semantic PASS and central raster PASS. Every original page in the frozen 18-page artifact was reviewed against the exact semantic route, source, component, write, field and custody bindings. No legal re-research, source acquisition, rebuild, reraster or shared-state mutation was performed.

claimEvidence.command: Existing VF44 reviewer assignment supplied by Captain; no claim-ledger command or ownership mutation was performed.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The current product wiring and sequential component set identify the exact Arkansas Veterans Treatment Court family: Stage 1 process guidance followed by the held ACIC petition and proposed-order pair. The four current PDF fixtures retain the Arkansas Veterans Treatment Court title and the same petition/order roles; no other route or instrument is represented.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: The held petition and order source bytes were read and matched their recorded SHA-256, byte lengths and page counts: petition 2a60285e…ff0a / 131167 bytes / 5 pages from the Master Library, and order dd73dfde…8ccf5 / 116034 bytes / 4 pages from tracked reference custody. The source receipt explicitly keeps the Master Library separate from the operational Nationwide corpus and preserves the stale printed citations. The recorded Act 691 PDF under /tmp is missing, but the receipt and adopted owner record state that it is not required for this source binding; no substitute or invented authority was used.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: The required three-component representation is present: Stage 1 participant process guidance, Stage 2 official ACIC petition, and Stage 2 official ACIC proposed order. Rendered-artifacts.json lists all four exact canonical/boundary PDF fixtures for the two official documents. No missing or extra generated component is promised.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Current actual-writes.json records only six petition writes and two proposed-order writes per fixture: collected participant case number, full legal name, first measured charge line and petition date of birth, with repeated caption name writes. The canonical and boundary PDFs read back those values; long boundary case/name values are recorded as fit or reduced-font, with no unfittable result. The production map offers only the six petition and two order mappings even though generic field-census projections identify additional fact-shaped blanks; those additional blanks are withheld by role. No court, prosecutor, judge, completion, service or agency fact is prefilled.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The two guides require Stage 1 records for adult status, charge/case, veteran or qualifying service-member status, qualifying disorder, assessment/treatment, team admission/approval and successful completion; they require the deferred/no-judgment branch, prosecutor recommendation, court/record comparison, and actor-owned completion. They also disclose same-level cross-court prerequisites, service timing, fee treatment and all participant/actor blanks. The blank inventory reports every blank disclosed to the participant.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: The branch record and guidance preserve the bounded pre-adjudication route, stop the generated-form branch for post-adjudication records while providing a supported current-instrument handoff, and make §16-90-1602(d) a conditional same-level handoff requiring completion, the other sentence completion, other-court agreement and other-judge signature. The old target checkbox, obsolete exclusion and generic concurrence are expressly rejected; DWI/BWI remains blocked until the §5-65-111 lookback. No branch is silently selected or broadened.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The held petition exposes one explicit measured charged-offense write box and the boundary fixture exercises a multi-offense string in that box; the charge-caption proof confirms no participant name leaked into charge blanks. Remaining charge/statute/status and all proposed-order charge blanks are withheld under their participant-record or court-owned roles and disclosed. No partial or unbounded generated row is claimed.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: The production map and blank inventory withhold 41 of 47 petition blanks and 40 of 42 order blanks. Those refusals cover venue and record-dependent facts, notary and service attestations, agency identifiers, court findings, completion/recommendation, cross-court agreement/signature, decree, judge execution and the old rehabilitation checkbox. Actual-writes.json reports no refused or unfittable fields, and current PDF text shows only the allowed participant values; the proposed order has only case number and name ink.

ARTIFACTS.finding: The Captain transfer record binds 25 file bodies and every current transfer hash matches, including all 22 family artifacts plus the builder and focused test. The four current PDFs match the frozen hashes, byte lengths and page counts in the author return and rendered-artifacts record. The saved native completeness sidecar reports PASS_COMPLETE with all nine author counters zero; this is consumed as build evidence and does not issue a visual or final verdict. Product wiring remains DECLARED_NOT_INSTALLED with generation, runtime and commercial non-grants.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: The component set is sequential: process guidance, petition, then proposed order. Each petition fixture is five pages and each order fixture is four pages, matching the held source page counts; rendered-artifacts.json lists canonical and boundary instances without a reordered or dropped source page. This is page identity/order evidence and does not measure visual placement.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All 18 original PNG pages from the completed current-byte RASTER_PASS artifact were hash-verified against the persisted page inventory and directly viewed. No clipping, overlap, missing ink, unreadable text, page-order defect, protected-field ink or boundary overflow was observed.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The packet is the ACIC Veterans Treatment Specialty Court petition/order route. The guidance requires confirmation that the court handled the case, comparison of court/county/case/offense to the current ACIC record, and service on the prosecuting attorney for the county where the petition is filed. Venue and court blanks remain participant/record or court-owned handbacks rather than being silently selected.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The current guided rule states a $0 uniform sealing-petition filing fee under §16-90-1419, generates no fee-waiver application for this no-fee petition, and keeps program, treatment/testing/supervision, public-defender, fines, restitution, court-cost and other-case obligations separate. This matches the adopted owner direction without inventing a payment or waiver result.

SERVICE.finding: The current guidance reconciles service to the adopted rule: serve the county prosecuting attorney within three days after filing; serve an arresting agency only when it is a named party; allow 30 days after receipt or filing, whichever is later, to oppose; and leave certified-order distribution after entry to the clerk. No service certificate, actor signature or post-order distribution is generated.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The participant-facing guidance stops the generated-form branch when the held pair does not fit or the record is post-adjudication, directs a supported current-instrument handoff without denying substantive relief, requires records before Stage 2, and directs participant/actor completion rather than manufacturing findings, recommendation, completion, service or signatures. It also identifies current-law, cross-court, DWI/BWI and separate-cost boundaries.
